historical_record.description: A building contract was recorded for glass work for a five-storey and basement reinforced concrete office building, at $2,349. B. G. McDougall was named as architect and W. P. Fuller & Co. as contractors for the glass work. The owner was the Mills Estate, Inc.

A building contract was recorded for tile for the flooring of a five-storey and basement reinforced concrete office building. Benjamin G. McDougall was named as architect and the Vitrolite Construction Co. as contractor for the tile. The owner was the Mills Estate, Inc.

A building contract was recorded for lighting fixtures, except in the basement and on the fifth floor, for a five-storey and basement reinforced concrete building, at $1,027.35. Benj. G. McDougall was named as architect and the Roberts Manufacturing Co. as contractor for the fixtures. The owner was the Mills Estate, Inc.

A building contract was recorded for a worm gear traction passenger elevator and an electric dumb waiter for a five-storey and basement reinforced concrete office building, at $5,600. B. G. McDougall was named as architect and the Otis Elevator Co. as contractor for the elevator. The owner was the Mills Estate, Inc.

A building contract was recorded for marble work for a five-storey and basement reinforced concrete office building, at $5,975. Benjamin G. McDougall was named as architect and the Jos. Musto Sons-Keenan Co. as contractor for the marble work. The owner was the Mills Estate, Inc.

A building contract was recorded for concrete and masonry work for a five-storey and basement reinforced concrete office building, at $22,670. B. G. McDougall was named as architect and Jas. L. McLaughlin as contractor for the concrete and masonry. The owner was the Mills Estate, Inc.
